info.submission: Fixed TypeError in cell 2 by filtering the dataframe to only include numeric columns before creating boxplots. The original code attempted to create boxplots for all columns including non-numeric ones, which caused seaborn to fail. The fix uses select_dtypes(include=[np.number]) to filter numeric columns, dynamically calculates appropriate subplot dimensions, and hides unused subplots.
